entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Undoubtedly, the believers reached their goals.
Those who totally humble themselves in their Salah.
And who do not incline towards vain talk.
And those that work to pay Zakah (consistently).
And those who protect their private parts.
Except from their wives or the lawful handmaids whom they possess; that there is no blame upon them.
So, whoever desires anything more than these two, only they are the transgressors.
And those who take care of their trusts and their promise.
And those who guard their Salah.
These people are the heirs.
That (they) will attain the inheritance of Paradise; they will abide therein forever.
Indeed, We created man from selected soil.
Then made him a drop of fluid in a strong resting place.

We then turned the drop of fluid into a clot of blood, then the clot of blood into a piece of flesh, then the piece of flesh into bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, then developed it into another form. So, Allah is the Most Auspicious, the Best Creator.
Then, you are certainly to die thereafter.
Then, you all will be raised on the Day of Resurrection.
And We have indeed created seven paths above you and We are not unaware of creation.
And We sent down water from the sky in a measured amount, then stored it in the earth. And We indeed have Power to take it away.
So, with it We produced gardens of date trees and grapes for you, therein is abundant fruit for you, and you eat therefrom.
And created the (olive) tree that comes forth from Mount Sinai, which grows containing oil and gravy for the eaters.
And in the cattle is indeed a lesson for you. We make you drink from that which is in their bellies, and there are many benefits for you in them, and in them is food for you.
And on them and on ship you are carried.
And We indeed sent Nooh towards his nation; so, he said, 'O my people! Worship Allah; you do not have any other god except Him, do you hence not have fear?'

So, the disbelieving chiefs of his people said, 'He is not but a human like you; he wishes to become your superior. And had Allah willed, He would have sent down angels. We did not hear about this from our early forefathers.'
'He is not but an insane man; therefore, wait for some time concerning him.'
Nooh submitted, 'O my Lord, help me (by destroying them), on this (reason); that they belied me.'

We henceforth sent him the revelation that 'In front of Us and by Our command, construct the Ark; then, when Our command comes and the clay oven gushed forth water, so, take into it a pair (male and female) of each species, and your family, except those upon whom the Word has already been decreed. And do not speak to Me regarding these unjust people (i.e. do not plead on their behalf); these (people) will definitely be drowned.'
'And when you and those with you have firmly boarded the Ark, then say, 'All praise is due to Allah Who has rescued us from these unjust people.'
And submit, 'O my Lord, cause me to disembark at a blessed place, and You are the Best to bring to land.'
Indeed, in this are definitely signs, and We were indeed definitely testing.
Then, after them, We created another generation.
So, We sent among them a Messenger (Hood) from them (who said), 'Worship Allah; you have no god except Him, so, do you not fear?'

And said the leaders of his people who disbelieved and denied being present in the Hereafter, and We gave them comfort in this worldly life; that 'He is nothing but a human like you, he eats from what you eat and drinks from what you drink.'
'If you were to obey a human like yourselves, you will thus definitely be in loss.'
'Does he (the Prophet Hood) promise you that when you die and turn into dust and bones, you will be raised again?'
'How far away is it, how far away is it; the promise that you are given?'
'There is nothing except our life of this world; that, we die and we live, and we are not to be brought back to life.'
'He is not but just a man, who has fabricated lie against Allah, and we are not to believe him.'
He submitted, 'O my Lord, help me on this; that, they have belied me.'
Said Allah, 'After a little while, in the morning, they will become regretful.'
So, the true scream seized them, We consequently made them (like the) rubbish of dry grass; away therefore with the unjust people.
Then, after them, We created other generations.
No nation can go ahead of its period (of death) nor stay behind.

We then sent our Messengers one after the other. Whenever a nation's Messenger came to it, they belied him. We consequently joined (their) latter ones with the former ones (in destruction) and made them stories (of the past); away therefore with the people who do not believe.
We then sent Moosa and his brother Haaroon with Our signs and clear authority.
Towards Fir'awn and his courtiers; they were therefore arrogant, and they were in a position of dominance.
So, they said, 'Shall we believe in two humans like ourselves; whereas, their nation for us is in servitude?'
So, they belied them both, they therefore became of those who were destroyed.
And We indeed gave Moosa the Book; that they may attain guidance.
And We made Maryam and her son a sign, and We gave them shelter on an elevated land; a place to stay and running water before (their) sight.
'O Messengers, eat pure things, and perform good deeds; I am aware of your actions.'
'And indeed, this religion of yours is only one religion (which is Islam), and I am your Lord; therefore, fear Me.'
But their nations broke their matter (i.e. their religion) into pieces; every group is happy with what it has.
Leave them therefore in their intoxication (of misguidance) until a (certain) time.
Do they assume that We are helping them by giving them wealth and sons.
(Because We) hasten to give them good things (in the earth)? (Never!) Rather, they are unaware.
Indeed, those who are in panic due to the fear of their Lord.
And those who believe in the verses of their Lord.
And those who do not ascribe any partner to their Lord.
And those who give whatever they give, and their hearts are fearing because (it is their firm belief that) they have to return to their Lord.
These people hasten to perform goodness, and it is they who are first to attain them (i.e. the good deeds).
And We do not burden any soul but according to its capacity, and with Us is a Book (i.e. the Preserved Tablet) that speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.
Rather, their hearts are in negligence of this (i.e. the Qur'aan) and their works (i.e. the works of the disbelievers) are different from those (of the believers) that they are doing.
Until, when We seized the wealthy amongst them with punishment, they immediately began pleading.
'Do not plead this Day; you will not be helped from Our side.'
'Indeed, My verses were being recited to you, you consequently used to turn back on your heels.'
'You boast on serving the Sacred Mosque; at night blabbering absurd stories therein, (whilst) discarding the truth.'
Have they not pondered over the Word (i.e. the Qur'aan), or did that come to them which did not come to their forefathers?
Or did they not recognise their Messenger; consequently, they think of him as an alien (denying him for this reason)?
Or they say, 'He is suffering from madness.' Rather, he brought the Truth (i.e. the Qur'aan) to them, and most of them dislike the truth.

And had the Truth (i.e. the Qur'aan) followed their desires, the heavens, and the earth and all those who are in between them would have henceforth definitely been destroyed. Rather, We have brought to them such a thing, in which there was fame for them; so, they are those who have actually turned away their faces from their own prestige.
Do you (O Beloved) ask any recompense from them? So, the reward of your Lord is the best; and He is the Best Provider of sustenance.
And indeed, you call them to the Straight Path.
And indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter have definitely deviated from the Straight Path.
And if We have mercy upon them and remove the calamity which has befallen them, they would still stubbornly persist, wandering in their rebellion.
And We indeed seized them in punishment; hence neither did they submit themselves in the Majestic Court of their Lord, nor do they humble themselves.
To the extent that when We opened the gate of any severe punishment upon them, they are lying in despair therein.
And it is He Who created ears, and eyes, and hearts for you; you appreciate very little.
And it is He Who has spread you on the earth, and only towards Him you are to be raised.
And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and in His authority is the alternation of night and day; do you not therefore have sense?
Rather, they said the same as what the former people used to say.
They said, 'What! When we die and turn into dust and bones, will we be raised again?'
'Indeed, this promise was given to us and before us to our forefathers; this is nothing but the same former (fabricated) stories.'
Say you (O Beloved), 'To whom does the earth and all that is therein belong, if you know?'
They will now say, 'To Allah.' Say you (O Beloved), 'Why do you not then ponder?'
Say you (O Beloved), 'Who is the Owner of the seven heavens and the Owner of the Great Throne?'
They will now say, 'This is the Grandeur of Allah.' Say you (O Beloved), 'Why do you not then fear?'
Say you (O Beloved), 'In whose hand is the control of all things? And He provides refuge, and no one can provide refuge against Him; if you know.'
They will now say, 'This is the Grandeur of Allah.' Say you (O Beloved), 'Then by what type of magic are you deceived?'
Rather, We brought the truth to them, and they are indeed liars.

Allah did not take (for Himself) any child, nor is there any other god with Him; if it was so, each god would have therefore taken away his creation, and each one would certainly seek superiority over the other. Purity is to Allah from those things which they fabricate.
(Allah is) the Knower of every concealed and visible; so, Supreme is He from what they associate.
Submit you (O Beloved); that 'O my Lord, if You show me what they are promised.'
'So, O my Lord, do not include me amongst the unjust.'
And We indeed have Power to show you what We are promising them.
Repel evil with that which is the best goodness; We know well the matters that they fabricate.
And you (O Beloved), submit (to educate your nation), 'O my Lord, I seek Your refuge from the evil suggestions of the Devil.'
'And O my Lord, I seek Your refuge; that lest they come to me.'
Until when death comes to any one of them (i.e. the disbelievers), he hence says, 'O my Lord, send me back.'

'Perhaps now I may do some good deeds which I have left behind therein (i.e. previously neglected).' Never! This is just a word that he utters from his mouth, and in front of them is a barrier until the Day in which they will be raised.
Thus, when the Trumpet will be blown, there will therefore neither be any relationship amongst them that Day, nor are they to ask about one another.
So, the ones whose scales prove to be heavy (with good deeds), only they are the successful.
And the ones whose scales prove light, it is they who had put their lives into ruin; they shall remain in Hell forever (due to their disbelief).
The Fire shall strike their faces, and they will remain therein with faces pulled up.
'Were My verses not recited upon you, you consequently used to belie them?'
They will say, 'O our Lord! Our misfortune overcame us, and we were people gone astray.'
'O our Lord! Remove us from Hell; if we then do the same (evil acts), we are therefore unjust.'
Allah will say, 'Remain accursed therein, and do not speak to Me.'
Indeed, there was a group amongst My bondsmen who used to say, 'O our Lord, we have believed, forgive us therefore and have mercy upon us, and You are the Best to bestow mercy.'
'You hence made them a laughingstock, until in making them (a laughingstock) you forgot My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.'
'Indeed, this Day for their patience I have rewarded them this; that only they are the successful ones.'
He (Allah) said, 'How long did you stay on earth, according to the number of years?'
They said, 'We stayed one day or part of a day; so, ask those who keep count (i.e. the angels).'
He said, 'You stayed not but only a little while, if you knew.'
So, do you think that We have created you in vain, and that you are not to return to Us?
Hence, Most Supreme is Allah; the True King; there is no one worthy of worship except Him; Owner of the Throne of Honour.
And the one who worships any other god along with Allah, of which he does not have any authority, his account is therefore with his Lord; indeed, there is no salvation for the disbelievers.
And submit you (O Beloved), 'O my Lord, forgive (the believers) and have mercy, and You are the Best to bestow mercy.'
